name: a mustachioed bartender
presence: polishes a glass behind the bar.
description: A broad man in a striped shirt and sleeve garters, with a waxed mustache he's plainly proud of. He keeps one eye on the door and the other on the till.

topics.emote: jerks his chin at the corner table.
topics.says: Game starts when there's enough fools to play it. House takes a cut, and the house is me.
Best whiskey in Dry Creek, on account of it being the only whiskey in Dry Creek.

topics.emote: smooths one waxed end with obvious pride.
topics.says: Takes discipline, friend. Discipline and wax.
That yellow mutt? Belongs to nobody. Eats better than I do.
Livery's down the street. Leave your horse there, not tied to my porch.
Trail runs west to the mesas. Folks go out that way. Fewer come back than you'd like.
Nearest law's three days' ride. Out here you mind your own manners.
The Silver Spur. Built her myself, mirror and all. Mirror cracked the first night.
Dry Creek. Creek's been dry since before I came. Town's been drying up after it.
Me? I pour, I listen, and I don't repeat what I hear. That's the whole job.

unknownTopic.says: Can't say I know much about that, stranger.

says: Card game starts when there's enough fools to play it.
emotes: polishes a glass that was already clean.
twists one end of his mustache thoughtfully.
glances at the batwing doors as they creak in the wind.

routine.presence: leans on the bar, counting the day's take.

emotes: counts a stack of coins, then counts it again.
turns the lamp down a little lower.

name: a red-nosed prospector
presence: slumps against the bar, nursing a glass.
description: A grizzled prospector with a nose like a ripe plum and dust in every crease of his coat. He's been nursing the same glass since noon, and it's been refilled more times than he'd admit. He hears everything and keeps none of it.

toldReply.emote: leans in far too close, eyes shining.

topics.emote: taps the side of his nose and misses.
topics.says: Secrets? Friend, you tell me a secret, it's the town's by suppertime. That's a promise.
Got a claim out past the mesas. Richest dirt in the territory. Ain't found the gold in it yet, is all.

topics.emote: peers into his glass, surprised to find it empty again.
topics.says: Just the one. Same one as before. Mostly.

topics.emote: lowers his voice, which doesn't help.
topics.says: Him? Hears everything, says nothing. Unnatural, is what it is.
Me? I'm a man of the earth. And the bottle. Mostly the bottle, lately.

says: Didja hear? No? Somebody oughta tell me something.
emotes: hums a tune that wanders off partway through.
nearly slides off his stool, then recovers with great dignity.
squints at the cracked mirror and toasts his reflection.

name: a rangy yellow dog
presence: sniffs along the edge of the boardwalk.
description: A long-legged yellow dog with burrs in its coat and one ear that won't stand up. It belongs to nobody and everybody.

topics.emote: perks up and thumps its tail hopefully.

unknownTopic.emote: tilts its head, one ear up and one ear down.

emotes: flops down in a patch of shade.
perks up at a distant sound, then loses interest.
